config.cost_note: one-way bps per position change; OOS also re-run at 2x
config.execution: signal on close t, trade at open t+1

hunt.stop_rule: stop at the first PASS (BH q < 0.10 over every test ever run) confirmed on lockbox markets

strategies.name: Buy & Hold
strategies.description: Always fully long.

strategies.name: SMA Crossover
strategies.description: Long when SMA(fast) > SMA(slow), else flat.

strategies.name: Trend Filter (close > SMA)
strategies.description: Long when close is above its n-day SMA.

strategies.name: Time-Series Momentum
strategies.description: Sign of the L-day return skipping the last 21 days; long/flat or long/short.

strategies.name: Donchian Breakout (Turtle)
strategies.description: Enter on close above prior N-day high, exit on close below prior M-day low.

strategies.name: MACD Signal Cross
strategies.description: Long when the MACD line is above its signal line.

strategies.name: RSI(2) Pullback
strategies.source: Connors & Alvarez, Short Term Trading Strategies That Work
strategies.description: Long when RSI(2) < x and close > SMA200; exit when close > SMA5.

strategies.name: RSI(14) Oversold (Reel Rule)
strategies.description: Enter RSI(14)<30 (optionally with close>SMA200); exit RSI(14)>60 or stop loss on close.

strategies.name: Bollinger Band Reversion
strategies.description: Long when close < SMA20 - k*std; exit when close > SMA20.

strategies.name: Internal Bar Strength
strategies.source: IBS reversal (Connors/Alvarez era; popular quant blogs)
strategies.description: Long when (close-low)/(high-low) < a; exit when > b.

strategies.name: Turn of the Month
strategies.description: Long the last N and first M trading days of each month.

strategies.name: Vol-Targeted Trend
strategies.description: SMA200 trend filter scaled by target vol / 20d realized vol, capped at 1.

strategies.name: Darvas Box Breakout
strategies.source: Nicolas Darvas, How I Made $2,000,000 in the Stock Market
strategies.description: Enter on close above a confirmed box top, exit on close below the box bottom.

strategies.name: N-Day Low Dip Buy
strategies.description: Long when close is the N-day closing low and above SMA200; exit after H days or close > SMA5.

strategies.name: Dual MA Long/Short
strategies.description: sma_cross that goes short (-1) instead of flat.

strategies.name: Pre-FOMC Drift
strategies.source: Lucca & Moench (2015), The Pre-FOMC Announcement Drift
strategies.description: Hold the sessions around scheduled Fed statement days (published calendar).

strategies.name: Pre-Holiday
strategies.description: Hold the last k sessions before an NYSE holiday (optionally the session after).

strategies.name: Options-Expiration Week
strategies.description: Hold during monthly opex week, the week after, or the two sessions into opex Friday.

strategies.name: Mid-Month Window
strategies.description: Hold sessions whose day-of-month is between d1 and d2.

strategies.name: Halloween (Sell in May)
strategies.description: Hold from Oct/Nov through Apr/May, flat in summer.

strategies.name: Santa Claus Rally
strategies.description: Hold the last sessions of December and first sessions of January.

strategies.name: Day-of-Week Filter
strategies.description: Hold only sessions starting on one weekday, or skip that weekday.

strategies.name: Quarter End / Start
strategies.source: Window dressing (Lakonishok et al. 1991); quarter-start inflows
strategies.description: Hold the last or first n sessions of each quarter.

strategies.name: Calendar Composite
strategies.source: Combination of turn-of-month, pre-holiday and pre-FOMC
strategies.description: Hold whenever any of the chosen calendar effects is active, optionally Nov-Apr only.

strategies.name: VIX Term Structure
strategies.source: Simon & Campasano (2014); VIX/VIX3M contango as a calm-regime signal
strategies.description: Long while VIX / VIX3M is below a threshold.

strategies.name: VIX Below Its Average
strategies.description: Long while VIX is below k times its n-day average.

strategies.name: VIX Spike Reversion
strategies.source: Connors, 'VIX stretches' (Short Term Trading Strategies That Work)
strategies.description: Buy for h sessions after VIX closes x above its 20-day average.

strategies.name: Realized-Vol Regime
strategies.description: Long while short-term realized vol is below its 1-year quantile.

strategies.name: Credit Trend (HYG/IEF)
strategies.source: Credit spreads lead equities (practitioner; Gilchrist & Zakrajsek 2012)
strategies.description: Long while high-yield bonds outperform Treasuries on trend.

strategies.name: Yield Curve
strategies.description: Long while the 10y-3m spread is positive / steepening.

strategies.name: Bond Trend Filter
strategies.source: Yield/credit trend as a macro filter (practitioner)
strategies.description: Long while 10y yields fall below trend, or investment-grade bonds trend up.

strategies.name: Dollar Trend
strategies.source: Dollar as a global risk barometer (practitioner)
strategies.description: Long while the US dollar index ETF is below / above its n-day average.

strategies.name: Faber 10-Month Timing
strategies.source: Faber (2007), A Quantitative Approach to Tactical Asset Allocation
strategies.description: At month-end, hold next month if price is above its N-month average.

strategies.name: Absolute Momentum
strategies.description: At month-end, hold next month if the trailing return beats T-bills.

strategies.name: Supertrend
strategies.description: Long while price is above the ratcheting ATR band.

strategies.name: Heikin-Ashi Trend
strategies.description: Enter after k green Heikin-Ashi candles, exit on the first red.

strategies.name: TTM Squeeze
strategies.description: Enter when the Bollinger-inside-Keltner squeeze fires with positive momentum.

strategies.name: Ichimoku Cloud
strategies.description: Long while price is above the cloud and tenkan > kijun.

strategies.name: Parabolic SAR
strategies.description: Long while the SAR is below price.

strategies.name: ADX / DMI
strategies.description: Long while +DI > -DI and ADX shows a trend.

strategies.name: Stochastic Oversold
strategies.description: Buy slow %K below x in an uptrend, exit above 80.

strategies.name: Williams %R
strategies.description: Buy %R below -90, exit above -20.

strategies.name: CCI
strategies.description: Buy CCI below -100 (reversion) or above +100 (trend).

strategies.name: Aroon
strategies.description: Long while Aroon-Up leads and is >= 70.

strategies.name: Hull Moving Average
strategies.description: Long while the HMA rises, or price is above it.

strategies.name: Kaufman Adaptive MA
strategies.source: Perry Kaufman, Trading Systems and Methods
strategies.description: Long while price is above KAMA, or KAMA rises.

strategies.name: Triple Moving Average
strategies.description: Long while fast > medium > slow SMA.

strategies.name: Breakout + Chandelier Exit
strategies.description: Enter on an n-day high, exit below the 22-day high minus k ATRs.

strategies.name: Consecutive Down Days
strategies.source: Connors & Alvarez, High Probability ETF Trading
strategies.description: Buy after n lower closes, sell on the first up close.

strategies.name: Double 7s
strategies.source: Connors & Alvarez, Short Term Trading Strategies That Work
strategies.description: Above SMA200, buy an n-day closing low and sell an n-day closing high.

strategies.name: Cumulative RSI
strategies.source: Connors & Alvarez, High Probability ETF Trading
strategies.description: Buy when RSI(2) summed over w days is below x in an uptrend.

strategies.name: Narrow Range (NR7)
strategies.source: Toby Crabel, Day Trading with Short Term Price Patterns
strategies.description: After the narrowest bar in n days closing strong in an uptrend, hold h sessions.

strategies.name: Inside Day
strategies.description: After an inside day, hold h sessions.

strategies.name: Weekly Reversal
strategies.description: After a week that fell more than x, hold the next week.

strategies.name: 52-Week-High Proximity
strategies.description: Long while close is within x of its 52-week high.

strategies.name: Z-Score Reversion
strategies.description: Buy a close more than thr std below its n-day mean, exit at the mean.

strategies.name: MA Envelope
strategies.description: Buy a close x below its n-day average, exit at the average.

strategies.name: Gap-Down Buy
strategies.description: After an unrecovered gap down of more than g, hold h sessions.

strategies.name: Volatility Breakout
strategies.source: Larry Williams, Long-Term Secrets to Short-Term Trading (close-confirmed)
strategies.description: If today closed above open + k x yesterday's range, hold h sessions.

strategies.name: Dip-Buy Consensus [chosen after results]
strategies.source: Combination chosen after seeing batch 0-4 results: IBS + Williams %R + RSI(2) + down days
strategies.description: Buy when at least m of 4 oversold signals agree; exit on a bounce.

strategies.name: Dip-Buy in Calm Markets [chosen after results]
strategies.source: Combination chosen after seeing batch 0-4 results: IBS + VIX term structure
strategies.description: IBS dip-buy only while VIX / VIX3M is below a threshold.

strategies.name: Dip-Buy in Low Vol [chosen after results]
strategies.source: Combination chosen after seeing batch 0-4 results: IBS + realized-vol regime
strategies.description: IBS dip-buy only while realized vol is below its 1-year quantile.

strategies.name: Dip-Buy or Calendar Window [chosen after results]
strategies.source: Combination chosen after seeing batch 0-4 results: IBS + turn of month + pre-holiday
strategies.description: In the market during IBS dip trades or calendar windows.

strategies.name: Trend + Cloud Agreement [chosen after results]
strategies.source: Combination chosen after seeing batch 0-4 results: SMA trend filter + Ichimoku (BTC near-misses)
strategies.description: Long while close is above SMA(n) and above the Ichimoku cloud.

strategies.name: Dip Entry, Trend Exit [chosen after results]
strategies.source: Combination chosen after seeing batch 0-4 results: RSI(2) dip entry + SMA trend exit
strategies.description: Enter on an RSI(2) dip in an uptrend, exit only when the trend breaks.

strategies.name: January Barometer
strategies.description: Hold January; stay in for the rest of the year only if January (or its first 5 days) was up.

strategies.name: Payday Anomaly
strategies.description: Hold the first n sessions on or after the 15th/16th of each month.

strategies.name: Crude Oil Predicts Stocks
strategies.description: Monthly: invested if last month's oil move predicts a return above T-bills.

strategies.name: All-Time-High Trend Following
strategies.description: Buy a close at the all-time high, exit on a k x ATR(10) trailing stop.

strategies.name: Asset-Class Momentum Rotation
strategies.description: Hold the 3 asset-class ETFs with the best 12-month return; monthly.

strategies.name: Asset-Class Trend Following
strategies.description: Each asset-class ETF held only above its 10-month average; monthly.

strategies.name: Sector Momentum Rotation
strategies.description: Hold the 3 sector ETFs with the best 12-month return; monthly.

strategies.name: Low-Volatility Sectors
strategies.description: Hold the least volatile sector ETFs (adaptation of the stock-level rule); monthly.

strategies.name: 12-Month Cycle (Sectors)
strategies.description: Rank sectors by their return in the same month last year; monthly.

strategies.name: Riding Industry Bubbles
strategies.description: Hold sectors whose 5-10 year CAPM alpha is statistically significant; monthly.

strategies.name: Country Momentum
strategies.description: Hold the 5 country ETFs with the best 10-12 month return; monthly.

strategies.name: Country Mean Reversion
strategies.description: Long the 4 worst countries over 3 years (short the 4 best); rebalance every 1-3 years.

strategies.name: 12-Month Cycle (Countries)
strategies.description: Rank countries by their return in the same month last year; monthly.

strategies.name: Betting Against Beta (Countries)
strategies.description: Long low-beta countries, short high-beta, beta-neutral; monthly.

strategies.name: Pairs Trading (Countries)
strategies.description: Distance-method pairs on country ETFs: trade divergences of the 5 closest pairs.

strategies.name: Paired Switching (Stocks/Bonds)
strategies.description: Hold whichever of stocks or bonds did better last quarter; re-decide each quarter.

strategies.name: January Effect (Small Caps)
strategies.description: Small caps in January, large caps the rest of the year.

strategies.name: Style Momentum Rotation
strategies.description: Long the best Russell style ETF by 6-12 month return (short the worst); monthly.

strategies.name: Commodity Momentum
strategies.description: Long the top commodity quintile by past return (short the bottom); monthly.

strategies.name: Commodity Skewness
strategies.description: Long the most negatively skewed commodities, short the most positively skewed; monthly.

strategies.name: Commodity Return Asymmetry
strategies.description: Long commodities with the fewest extreme up-days relative to down-days; monthly.

strategies.name: Currency Momentum
strategies.description: Long the 3 strongest currencies vs USD over 12 months, short the 3 weakest; monthly.

strategies.name: Cross-Asset Time-Series Momentum
strategies.description: Long assets with positive 12-month returns, short negative, volatility-weighted; monthly.
